overstay.text: Under Decree 282/2025/NĐ-CP, a foreigner who stays past the term of their temporary residence certification without permission is fined by length of overstay: VND 500,000 to 2,000,000 for under 16 days; 5,000,000 to 10,000,000 for 16 to under 30 days; 10,000,000 to 15,000,000 for 30 to under 60 days; 15,000,000 to 20,000,000 for 60 to under 90 days; 20,000,000 to 25,000,000 for 90 to under 180 days; 25,000,000 to 30,000,000 for 180 days to under 1 year; and 30,000,000 to 40,000,000 for 1 year or more. Expulsion may also be imposed for overstays of 16 days or more. Under the Law on Entry, Exit, Transit and Residence of Foreigners, the immigration control unit grants every foreigner entering Viet Nam this temporary residence certification, and the foreigner may stay within its term.

postArrivalRegistration.penaltyText: An accommodation establishment that does not declare temporary residence is fined VND 3,000,000 to 5,000,000 for 1 to 3 foreigners, VND 10,000,000 to 15,000,000 for 4 to 8 foreigners, and VND 15,000,000 to 20,000,000 for 9 or more (Decree 282/2025/NĐ-CP, Art. 21).
postArrivalRegistration.text: A foreigner staying temporarily in Viet Nam declares temporary residence through the manager of the accommodation establishment to the commune, ward or township police, or the police station or post, where the establishment is located. The establishment must ask the foreigner to show a passport or international travel document, and papers on residence in Viet Nam, before agreeing to let the foreigner stay. The declaration is made electronically or on a paper form. With a paper form, the manager must deliver it within 12 hours, or 24 hours in remote areas, of the foreigner's arrival. faq.question: Do US citizens need a visa for Vietnam?
faq.answer: US passport holders are not among the visa-exempt nationalities in the government resolutions we read, and Vietnam issues e-visas to citizens of all countries — 25 USD single entry or 50 USD multiple entry, valid up to 90 days — at evisa.gov.vn (or thithucdientu.gov.vn). Processing typically takes 3 working days, or 3 to 15 when the application needs verification.

faq.question: Which nationalities can enter Vietnam without a visa?
faq.answer: Government resolutions exempt citizens of the UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland, Japan, South Korea and Russia from visas for stays of 45 days from entry, from 15 March 2025 to 14 March 2028; and citizens of Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czechia, Hungary, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia and Switzerland for 45 days for tourism under the Tourism Stimulus Program, from 15 August 2025 to 14 August 2028. No official page we could read lists the other exemptions.

faq.question: How much does the Vietnam eVisa cost and how long does it take?
faq.answer: The e-visa costs 25 USD for single entry or 50 USD for multiple entry, is valid for up to 90 days, and is typically processed within 3 working days, or 3 to 15 working days when the application needs verification (working days exclude weekends and public holidays). It is available to citizens of all countries and territories.

faq.question: Can I extend my stay in Vietnam?
faq.answer: No official source we could read describes extending an e-visa. The e-visa portal says e-visas are not issued to foreigners already in Viet Nam, and that e-visa holders in Viet Nam may be eligible for a new visa if invited or guaranteed by an authority, organization or individual in Viet Nam.

faq.question: Does Vietnam require an arrival card or customs declaration?
faq.answer: The UK Foreign Office says that since 15 April 2026 foreign nationals arriving at Tan Son Nhat Airport in Ho Chi Minh City are encouraged to complete a digital arrival card online before arrival; it is not currently mandatory, but this may change or extend to other airports with limited notice. It says you must declare cash over 15 million dong or 5,000 US dollars.

Cơ sở lưu trú có trách nhiệm yêu cầu người nước ngoài xuất trình hộ chiếu hoặc giấy tờ có giá trị đi lại quốc tế, giấy tờ liên quan đến cư trú tại Việt Nam để thực hiện khai báo tạm trú trước khi đồng ý cho người nước ngoài tạm trú.
2. Việc khai báo tạm trú cho người nước ngoài thực hiện qua môi trường điện tử hoặc phiếu khai báo tạm trú.
